observations.inspectedFrom: eBay seller image (the listing's only image), 1600x1554 JPEG from i.ebayimg.com, read from the listing by the owner's local session and visually inspected
observations.observed: French Ronflex-GX SM05 black star promo, PV 190, Effondrement 80, Ronflement Tonitruant 180, Gare au Ronflex GX 210, Illus. 5ban Graphics, (c)2016, scanned beside a standard-size Pokemon card back: the card is about twice as tall and wide, i.e. the jumbo (oversized) printing. Holofoil swirl across artwork and frame. Listing title 'carte Pokémon SM05 Ronflex GX JUMBO Promo NEUF FR'.

physicalObservation.basis: The image places the card beside a standard-size card back, which shows the oversized size; holofoil across artwork and frame.
